summary.text: Lee Bright is a Republican member of the South Carolina Senate for District 12, which covers Greenville and Spartanburg Counties.
He was elected in a special election on December 23, 2025, to fill the unexpired term of Roger A. Nutt, who resigned.

paragraphs.text: Bright was born on March 21, 1970, in Greer, and works in insurance; his page lists Dorman High School, 1988.
He served on the District Six school board from 1999 to 2003.
He previously served in the Senate from 2009 to 2016.
His current committees are Agriculture and Natural Resources, Banking and Insurance, Family and Veterans' Services, Fish, Game and Forestry, and Judiciary.
